name: Sachan Zaru Ganba
desc:
Sachan Zaru Ganba is an Etrean NPC. He is the head of the Ganba Clan.

In an argument with the three other Sachans in [The Golden Rat](location:the_golden_rat), he asked to find a way to contact the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) for a potential new operating base. He seems to know that [The Inheritor](entity:the_inheritor) is apart of the [Circle of Honour](faction:circle_of_honour), and he considers joining the organization himself.
additional_info: -   When the camera is clipped inside his katana, the blade is a yellow color reflecting his clan's color scheme.
goals: Contact the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) to establish a new base against [the Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent)
Join [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions) in the west, should that fail
